description: This file defines the class Zend_Translate_Adapter_XmlTm, a translation adapter for handling XMLTM files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for loading translation data, parsing XML, and managing translation entries.

classes.name: Zend_Translate_Adapter_XmlTm
classes.description: A translation adapter class for reading XMLTM files using PHP's XML parser, extending Zend_Translate_Adapter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with data, locale, and options.

methods.name: _loadTranslationData
methods.description: Loads translation data from an XMLTM file, parsing its contents and storing translations.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing, initializing tags.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, storing translation entries.

methods.name: _contentElement
methods.description: Accumulates character data within XML elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter, 'XmlTm'.
